'''Korvalis''' was an individual who became a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Cularin Militia]], a military force that was active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Korvalis and Sergeant [[C. Drover]] together formed and trained [[Division Cloud Force]], a Militia unit that was specialized for operations in zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] environments.
